meaning:
1) to make distinct, declare, distinguish, separate
1a) (Qal) to declare, clarify
1b) (Pual) to be distinctly declared
Aramaic equivalent: pe.rash (פְּרַשׁ "to make clear" H6568)

elsewhere.note: They put him in custody until Yahweh’s will should be declared to them.
They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.
They read in the book, in the law of God, distinctly; and they gave the sense, so that they understood the reading.
In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.
As a shepherd seeks out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered abroad, so I will seek out my sheep. I will deliver them out of all…
